content: react-markdown v10.1.0 (March 2025): Install: npm install react-markdown. Usage: import Markdown from 'react-markdown'; <Markdown>{markdownString}</Markdown>. Safe by default (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML). Renders semantic HTML (h1-h6, ul, li, p, strong, em). Supports plugin architecture (remark/rehype plugins). Uses named export 'Markdown' not default in some versions. Pair with @tailwindcss/typography prose class for styled output.
